response.sql: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg FROM fee_groups) SELECT orderslink, side, avg_net_fee_rate, record_count, avg_net_fee_rate - side_avg AS difference FROM compared WHERE avg_net_fee_rate > side_avg ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
